what: A report started on a job that Ahmedabad executes for a Mumbai contract is saved with NO client and NO vendor (IRN …/GEN/IR/000001). Submit for review is then blocked ('Client identified — No client — set it on the call'; 'Vendor / manufacturer identified'). The Ahmedabad inspector and Ahmedabad coordinator cannot fix it: their client and vendor lists only offer their own office's records. Only the Mumbai (contracting) coordinator could set them. Cause: views/doc_form client/vendor pick lists use partner_office_sql() (lib/idems.php ~5113) so the work order's Mumbai client is not offered and is dropped.
rule: docs/04-flows/branch_manager.md 'Cross-office money (ADR-005)' — the executing office carries out and reports work another branch sold; QA-REPORTS/V51/30 Point 6 (the executing office or the report's inspector submits).

what: The next stage report was numbered MGH/AHM/2026/TBSTEE/IR/000001 — a new series and serial 000001 — instead of the next number in the same series as the stage 1 report MGH/AHM/2026/GEN/IR/000001 (…/IR/000002). (Triggered here because stage 1 was created without a client — finding above — but the batch-2 promise 'next number in the same series' is not kept.)
rule: QA-REPORTS/V51/30 'B — Start next stage report': a new draft with the next number in the same series.

screen: /to-bill → Draft invoice for the ticked work
what: A draft made in the Billing workspace for a job on Mumbai contract MUM/C/2026-27/00001 was raised under BRANCH Ahmedabad and issued as AHM/2627/0001 (Finance's home office), with CONTRACT — and due date = invoice date although the client has 45 credit days. Consequence: Mumbai (the contracting office that sold the work) shows REVENUE BILLED ₹0 and 'Nothing was executed' on Profit by work order, while Ahmedabad shows the client revenue ₹5,541. The job-page and billable-events paths use invoice_office_for() (contracting office); booksui.php invoice-new (Billing workspace) does not pass an office, so books_invoice_create() falls back to the user's home office. Extends known DEF-FLOW-008 (A5).
rule: docs/04-flows/branch_manager.md: 'Invoicing and payment totals belong to the branch that raises the invoice' with the contracting office invoicing (FLOW-09: 'contracting office invoices, executing office allocates and earns the credit'); lib/ops.php:7746 invoice_office_for().

what: With Money → Tally export → 'Our state' not set (as on a fresh copy; company profile says Gujarat), an invoice to a Maharashtra GSTIN (27…) is drafted as CGST + SGST and Issue is allowed. The page itself says 'OUR STATE not set'. books_issue_missing() (lib/books.php:730) checks only the place of supply, although the comment at books_is_igst() (lib/books.php:325) says issue is refused until the state is set. A tax invoice goes out with the wrong GST type.
rule: lib/books.php:325-327 comment ('books_issue_missing() refuses to issue until somebody sets the state'); GST rule inter-state = IGST.

what: Mumbai contract MUM/C/2026-27/00001 was given its first signature by Ahmedabad's Test OpsMgr and then opened ('opened and floated to operations') by Ahmedabad's Test BranchMgr. The final approval list names 'Test BranchMgr2, Test BAM, Test BranchMgr'. can_endorse_contract_open()/can_approve_contract_open() check the role, not the contract's office.
rule: docs/01/02 and QA-REPORTS/V51/27 Part 1: Branch Manager, Operation Manager, Branch App Manager see their own office only.

what: Test KAM (Mumbai) created a costing with Executing office Ahmedabad: it was saved as AHM/PC/2026-27/11/0001 and the creator was immediately sent to the dashboard with 'This costing is outside your office / branch scope' — the person who just made it can no longer open, finish or submit it.
rule: docs/04-flows (Sales): the salesperson builds and submits the costing for their deal; a save must not lock out its own author.

what: On 17 Nov 2026 the coordinator could close the visit days of 19 and 20 Nov 2026 (future dates), and both days were tied to the stage 2 report.
rule: docs/03 ## Job: open visit-days hold the job open; a day not yet reached cannot have been inspected (owner decision needed if allowed on purpose).

what: A quotation drafted from a costing shows LEAD — and OPPORTUNITY — in its thread bar although it carries the lead (the work order made from it shows both), and the enquiry's contact (Meera Kulkarni) is not carried: Contact '—'.
rule: UI blueprint: one thread from lead to money; the costing was made for that enquiry and lead.

what: For the same job, Profit by work order shows REVENUE ₹5,541 / PROFIT ₹4,291 while the Contract number register shows INVOICING DONE ₹5,540.54 / PROFIT ₹4,290.54; the job record stores invoice amount ₹5,540.54 against an invoice total of ₹5,541 (round-off ₹0.46 left out). Two screens disagree by 46 paise. (Both also include GST — known DEF-FIN-009.)
rule: One figure per fact across screens (brief: totals that must add up across screens).

what: The tile reads 'UNBILLED ₹4,695.38 — 0 job(s) to invoice' while two man-day units of that job are due to bill.
rule: Zero Training UI: a tile's figure and its caption must agree.

what: Posting a requisition to the Marketplace copies our internal costing into the public description: 'Basic 20,000 · HRA 8,000 · Special allowance 18,638 · PF 2,400 · Gratuity 962. Loaded cost 54,500, billed at 71,531 (23.8% margin).' An outside professional sees it on /pro/jobs. The requirement could also be opened for applications with rate ₹0–₹0.
rule: docs/02 data.salary / data.revenue: salary and what the branch earns are restricted even inside the company (lib/ops.php:735-739).

what: With a salary structure of ₹50,000 a month (₹6,00,000 a year) the offer stores CTC 0 and the Offer row reads '₹0'; after Hired + Joined the new team member Asha Patel (EMP20) has salary CTC 0, so the person's cost on every job reads ₹0. The candidate's stored stage also stays 'CV received'.
rule: docs/02 note 406 ('the candidate's actual monthly CTC (offer, else salary structure)'); offer letter must state the CTC.

what: After 'Offer marked declined' the candidate stays '🔒 Locked — in recruitment with Ahmedabad' (stage Offer Letter); other offices cannot open or re-use the person until someone also moves the stage to Withdrawn.
rule: docs/02 §8 candidate lock (5): the lock is lifted when the process ends — 'rejected / withdrawn / offer declined / did not join / dropped'.

what: Accepting a TB Steel Works portal request as Test Coord2 (Mumbai) creates CALL-00002 with no contracting office, no executing office, no contract, no quote and ₹0, and the same screen then says 'This inspection call is outside your office / branch scope' — the coordinator who raised it cannot open it.
rule: QA-REPORTS/V51/30 point 11 (requests belong to the client's office); a work order must carry its contracting office (lib/ops.php invoice_office_for() relies on it).

what: Cancelling a work order whose stage 1 report is issued leaves JOB-00001 allocated and open, and it stays on Test Inspector's My Jobs schedule for 19 and 20 Nov. The message also says 'Call assigned to Test Inspector … stage: Allocated' after the cancel.
rule: docs/03 ## Job: a job's only stage write is CANCELLED (tosrm.php:656); a cancelled order should not send an engineer.

what: A nonconformity raised against JOB-00001 (TB Steel Works) stores no client: 'CLIENT / PARTY —'. It will not show on the client's quality history.
rule: Same thread from job to quality record (docs/03 NCR source JOB).

what: CAPA EFFECTIVENESS stays 'No data' after CAPA-2026-001 was verified effective and closed (known DEF-FLOW-004, still present in release 74a263f).

Known defects re-seen on release 74a263f (not new, listed so they are not counted twice): DEF-SAL-011 contract value includes GST (₹66,486.58 for a ₹56,344.56 quotation); DEF-FIN-009 Profit by work order and Management dashboard revenue include GST (₹5,541 instead of ₹4,695.38); DEF-FLOW-008/A5 draft invoice loses contract and credit days (due date = invoice date for a 45-day client); DEF-REP-006 'Generate report' covered on the phone; DEF-FLOW-003 complaint drops the job; DEF-FLOW-002 man-month deputation valued per day (FLOW-02 on this copy: allocation form ₹7,21,035, deputation ₹1,86,2…).

A ₹21,000 voucher sent back by the Director (status Draft, not approved) still shows as VOUCHER ₹21,000 on JOB-00001 in Profit by work order (TOTAL COST ₹22,250, PROFIT −₹16,709). A claim that has not been approved, or was rejected, is already treated as a cost of the job.
rule: docs/03 ## Voucher: only an approved voucher is payable; profit should not move before approval (owner to confirm Approved vs Paid).
